items.content_html: A lightweight, custom-built audio and video communication web application designed for internal use at hotel reception desks. This system relies on a pure WebRTC Peer-to-Peer (Mesh) architecture. Media streams are routed directly between clients, ensuring data privacy and removing the need for dedicated media servers (SFU/MCU).
